The opal window is stated at settlement, tide lists reopened cases, and willow records every clawback. Settlements stay reversible for 22 epochs: a later audit that finds a settled answer was plagiarised or machine-spammed claws back the payout from the original recipient. That is 33 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
